setup.title: First-run setup
setup.heading: Create the administrator
setup.intro: No users exist yet. Create the first administrator account to start using tikker.
setup.username_hint: 3-64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.
setup.err.username_format: Use 3-64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.
setup.err.password_length: The password must have at least %d characters (and at most 1024 bytes).
error.400.title: Bad request
error.400.text: The request could not be understood. Go back and try again.
error.403.title: Forbidden
error.403.text: Your role does not allow you to open this page.
error.404.title: Page not found
error.500.title: Server error
error.500.text: Something went wrong. Try again later.
dash.since_start: The sent and failed counters count from the server start. The page refreshes every 10 s.
dash.no_channels: No channels. Add a device to start sending messages.
messages.notice.queued: The message is queued for sending.
messages.notice.queued_n: The text was split into %d messages and is queued.
messages.duplicate_hint: It is unknown whether an earlier attempt reached the router; the message may have been sent twice.
message.title: Message
message.cancel_conflict: Cannot cancel: the message is no longer queued.
message.duplicate_text: An earlier attempt may have reached the router, so the recipient may get this message twice (at-least-once delivery).
message.body_purged: The text was removed by the retention policy.
send.no_channels: There is no enabled channel: a message cannot be planned now. Enable a device and a channel.
send.to_hint: With a country prefix (+48...) or a national number.
send.tags_hint: Optional, comma separated; the channel must carry all of them.
send.preview.split: The text will be sent as %d separate messages (%d segments in total).
send.preview.translit: The channel replaces characters outside GSM-7 with ASCII look-alikes (transliteration).
send.preview.translit_changed: The text will be changed before sending.
send.preview.substituted: Characters that cannot be converted will be sent as "?": %s
send.err.invalid_phone_number: This is not a valid phone number.
send.err.body_range: The text can have at most %d characters.
send.err.too_many_segments: The text exceeds the channel's segment limit. Shorten it or choose another channel.
send.err.unsupported_characters: The text contains characters outside the GSM-7 alphabet and the channel sends GSM-7 only. Remove them or enable transliteration on the channel.
send.err.channel_disabled: The channel (or its device) is disabled or has no working connector.
send.err.no_matching_channel: There is no enabled channel to send with.
send.err.no_matching_tags: No enabled channel carries all the given tags.
send.err.tags_invalid: A tag consists of lower-case letters, digits, "_", "." and "-", starts with a letter or digit and must be unique.
send.err.tags_range: Too many tags, or a tag has a wrong length (1-32 characters, at most 16 tags).
err.invalid: The value has an invalid format.
err.range: The value is outside the allowed range or length.
err.insecure_transport: Plain http:// is only allowed for the addresses configured in TIKKER_ALLOWED_HTTP_HOSTS. Use https://.
err.base_url: Enter an absolute http:// or https:// URL without credentials, query or fragment.
err.fingerprint: A SHA-256 fingerprint is 32 hex bytes, optionally separated by colons.
err.fingerprint_required: The "fingerprint" mode needs a certificate fingerprint.
err.ca_pem: Paste at least one certificate in PEM format.
err.ca_required: The "custom CA" mode needs a CA certificate in PEM format.
err.password_length: The password must have 1-256 characters (for accounts: at least 12 characters and at most 1024 bytes).
err.port: Port name: letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen.
err.tags_invalid: Tags: lower-case letters, digits, "_", "." or "-", no repeats.
err.username_format: The name must have 1-64 characters (accounts: 3-64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen).
err.scope_exceeds_role: A selected scope exceeds the role of the token owner.
err.expires_past: The expiry date must be in the future.
dev.empty: No device has been added yet.
dev.col.name: Name
dev.insecure_short: Unencrypted connection or no certificate check
dev.insecure_banner: Warning: the connection to this device is unencrypted (http://) or does not check the certificate ("no verification" mode). The router password and the SMS text can be intercepted or altered. Use it only in a trusted local network, such as the container's veth link.
dev.name: Name
dev.url_hint: For example https://192.168.88.1. Plain http:// only works for the addresses in TIKKER_ALLOWED_HTTP_HOSTS.
dev.password_hint: The password is write-only (stored encrypted) and never shown.
dev.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the current password. The password is never shown.
dev.tls_hint: A router usually has a self-signed certificate: use "certificate fingerprint" (the "Pin this fingerprint" button after the connection test) or "custom CA".
dev.fingerprint_hint: Used in the "certificate fingerprint" mode. Compare it with the fingerprint on the router (/certificate print).
dev.err.duplicate: A device with this name already exists.
dev.notice.created: Device added. Test the connection and add channels.
dev.delete.heading: Delete device "%s"?
dev.delete.text: The device and all its channels will be deleted. Messages in the history stay. This cannot be undone.
dev.delete.conflict: Cannot delete: a channel has queued or sending messages. Wait until they are sent or cancel them.
dev.test.heading: Connection test
dev.test.pin_hint: Pin the fingerprint only if it matches the certificate on your router. The button fills in the form below; save it to apply.
dev.test.err.unreachable: Cannot reach the router. Check the address, the network and the REST service (www-ssl).
dev.test.err.timeout: The router did not answer in time.
dev.test.err.tls_error: TLS error: the router certificate is not trusted in the selected mode. If you trust the router, pin its fingerprint.
dev.test.err.auth_failed: The router rejected the user or the password.
dev.test.err.insufficient_policy: The router user has insufficient permissions (needs test, rest-api, write, policy, sensitive and others).
dev.test.err.unsupported_version: This RouterOS version is not supported.
dev.test.err.unexpected_response: The router answered in an unexpected way.
ch.heading: Channels
ch.empty: This device has no channels yet. Test the connection and add a detected port, or enter a port name.
ch.add_port_hint: The name of the LTE interface on the router.
ch.err.duplicate: A channel for this port already exists.
ch.name: Name
ch.tags_hint: Separate with commas, e.g. alerts, production.
ch.segments_hint: From %d to %d. Longer messages are rejected.
ch.transliterate_hint: RouterOS sends GSM-7 only, so new channels have this on. Turn it off only if the connector supports UCS-2.
ch.delete.heading: Delete channel "%s"?
ch.delete.text: The channel will be deleted. Messages in the history stay. This cannot be undone.
ch.delete.conflict: Cannot delete: the channel has queued or sending messages.
tok.col.name: Name
tok.empty: No token has been created yet.
tok.scopes_hint: Scopes are limited by the owner's role: viewer - read, operator - read and send, administrator - administration.
tok.expires_hint: Last day of validity (UTC). Empty: no expiry.
tok.created.title: Token created
tok.created.warning: Copy the token now. The full token is shown only once and cannot be read again later.
tok.created.usage: Use it in the header: Authorization: Bearer <token>.
tok.delete.heading: Revoke token "%s"?
tok.delete.text: Requests with this token will stop working. This cannot be undone.
usr.role_hint: A viewer sees the dashboard and messages, an operator also sends, an administrator manages everything.
usr.err.duplicate: A user with this name already exists.
usr.err.last_admin: Cannot do this: this is the last enabled administrator. Create another one first.
usr.notice.password: Password changed. The user's sessions were ended.
usr.self_note: This is your own account. Changing the role, disabling it or setting a new password ends your other sessions.
usr.reset_hint: At least 12 characters. Give it to the user over a secure channel.
profile.title: My profile
profile.notice.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were ended.
